{{Top|leg}}
[[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] society was organized into a series of '''Circles''' prior to the invasion of their territory by the [[Tof/Legends|Tof]]. Each Circle was further sub-divided into a number of Sub-circles, and an individual Nagai's place within a Circle was determined by their [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]]. Their position within the Circle was a sign of status, with members of lower Sub-circles not being allowed to mate with members of higher levels. A Nagai could move up through the ranks of Sub-circles by displaying feats of physical prowess.<ref name="Marvel">{{GamerCite|1|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Marvel Series}}</ref>

During the [[Nagai–Tof War]], the system of Circles broke down, with Circles combining to survive the invasion and entire Sub-circles being eradicated by the Tofs. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Circles still existed but they were no longer the solid foundation upon which Nagai society had been built on. The loss of entire Sub-circles had resulted in individual raising in rank purely by default, and mating between the Sub-circles had become more common. Some Nagai talked of even abandoning the Circles altogether.<ref name="Marvel" />
